requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1704-2466-4836--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-2466-4836--227.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary permanent you control, untapping it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

250-779-1479-5412-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5412-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1170-5131-7692-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-7692-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

360-1981-2415-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6259-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

749-2092-4549-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Lena from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Lena, adding {B}.
Activate Lena by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1169-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1402-3593-4359-5226.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

1069-3552-5499-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5499-7175.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1409-2097-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

225-539-4518-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison.
Repeat.

323-1894-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur

1617-4831-4983-5358-6913.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Chameleon to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

539-2783-5649-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with seven or more loyalty counters

193-1180-2247-3656.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Karn's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it, causing a player to exile a card from their hand.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
During your next turn, activate Nicol Bolas using Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas, causing it to re-enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on it.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Karn's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it, causing a player to exile a card from their hand.
Repeat.
193-1180-2247-3656.notes: This combo requires a turn of setup before getting infinite turns. If you are able to activate Teferi or Nicol Bolas for infinite turns, you may do so to get around this.

1902-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1902-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
1902-4067-5672.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1737-2099-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

222-527-1753-2292.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1753-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1974-2092-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Gargantuan and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
1974-2092-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Quicksilver Gargantuan and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Quicksilver Gargantuan to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

902-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have visited at least one Attraction this turn.
902-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squirrel Squatters as attackers.
Squirrel Squatters triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Squirrel token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

635-2351-4549.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Tentacle.
It is not your turn.
The Watcher has zero stun counters on it.
635-2351-4549.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Watcher, adding {U}.
Activate Drowned Rusalka by paying {U} and sacrificing a Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Drowned Rusalka trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

2584-3276-3496.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, causing Dread Slaver to deal three damage to itself and die due to its deathtouch ability.
Dread Slaver dies, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2034-3263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {2}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

950-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
